name: 97504 · Medford, OR
findings: ZIP 97504 (Medford) has 182 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97504 (Medford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
